title: Spaghetti Carbonara
description: A classic Roman pasta dish that's creamy, indulgent, and surprisingly simple to make. Rich with eggs, cheese, pancetta, and black pepper, it delivers maximum flavor with minimal ingredients.

steps.text: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti until al dente.
Meanwhile, sauté the pancetta in a skillet over medium heat until crispy and golden.
Whisk together eggs, egg yolks, and grated Pecorino Romano in a bowl until creamy.
Drain pasta (reserve 1 cup of cooking water) and toss with the pancetta in the skillet.
Remove from heat, add the egg mixture, and stir quickly, adding reserved water as needed for creaminess. Season generously with black pepper and serve immediately.

notes: Use guanciale if you can; move fast off-heat so the eggs don’t scramble.
